color.$description: Primitive color palette. $type is set once here and inherited by every token below it. $value is the Color Module's structured object, not a bare hex string — colorSpace/components are the source of truth, hex is only a fallback.

900.$description: Near-black, used as the default text color on light surfaces.

com.example.tool.note: Vendor/tool-specific data lives under a reverse-domain key inside $extensions; the spec does not define its contents.

semantic.$description: Semantic aliases resolve to primitives via {group.token} references, so themes can repoint them without touching consumers. A curly-brace reference always resolves to the target token's whole $value, regardless of shape.

muted.$deprecated: Renamed to semantic.color.surface.subtle; kept for one release cycle.
